result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d make it easier for people to understand each other deeply and act in good faith.

Not agreement—just better understanding. If more conversations started with curiosity instead of defensiveness, many problems—conflict, inequality, misinformation, even loneliness—would become easier to address.
